optionalfeature.name: Cannon Mastery

entries: {@b Starship gunning mastery.} Usable only while deployed aboard a starship—not in ground combat.

You are the master of laser cannons. While you are firing a primary weapon, when you take the {@variantrule Fire|sw5e-sotg} action, you can choose to fire rapidly at the expense of accuracy. Your attacks are made without the aid of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, but you use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to make an additional attack, also without your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

optionalfeature.name: Heavy Gun Mastery

entries: {@b Starship gunning mastery.} Usable only while deployed aboard a starship—not in ground combat.

You are the master of railguns and turbolasers. While you are firing a secondary weapon, before you make an attack, you can choose to double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. If the attack hits, you reduce the damage dealt by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

optionalfeature.name: Payload Mastery

entries: {@b Starship gunning mastery.} Usable only while deployed aboard a starship—not in ground combat.

You are the master of missiles, rockets, and other ship-board explosive weapons. While you are firing a tertiary or quaternary weapon, you can choose to reduce the DC by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. If you do, and the target fails the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, they take additional damage equal to twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.
